// Generated test input; copy into the exact upstream package, then run go test.
package metrics

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus"
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestRustParityCollectorOracle(t *testing.T) {
	initMetrics(prometheus.Labels{"cluster": "oracle"})
	ResourceGroupStatusGauge.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Set(1.25)
	SuccessfulRequestDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Observe(1.25)
	FailedLimitReserveDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Observe(1.25)
	FailedRequestCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1", "variable2").Add(1.25)
	GroupRunningKVRequestCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Set(1.25)
	RequestRetryCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Add(1.25)
	TokenRequestDuration.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	ResourceGroupTokenRequestCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1").Add(1.25)
	LowTokenRequestNotifyCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Add(1.25)
	TokenConsumedHistogram.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	RequestSourceRUCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0", "variable1", "variable2", "variable3").Add(1.25)
	CopReadPrechargeCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Add(1.25)
	CopReadNoPrechargeCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Add(1.25)
	PagingPrechargeBytesCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Add(1.25)
	PagingActualBytesCounter.WithLabelValues("variable0").Add(1.25)
	PagingPredictionResidualBytes.WithLabelValues("variable0").Observe(1.25)
	FailedTokenRequestDuration.Observe(2)
	SuccessfulTokenRequestDuration.Observe(3)
	collectors := map[string]prometheus.Collector{
		"ResourceGroupStatusGauge":         ResourceGroupStatusGauge,
		"SuccessfulRequestDuration":        SuccessfulRequestDuration,
		"FailedLimitReserveDuration":       FailedLimitReserveDuration,
		"FailedRequestCounter":             FailedRequestCounter,
		"GroupRunningKVRequestCounter":     GroupRunningKVRequestCounter,
		"RequestRetryCounter":              RequestRetryCounter,
		"TokenRequestDuration":             TokenRequestDuration,
		"ResourceGroupTokenRequestCounter": ResourceGroupTokenRequestCounter,
		"LowTokenRequestNotifyCounter":     LowTokenRequestNotifyCounter,
		"TokenConsumedHistogram":           TokenConsumedHistogram,
		"RequestSourceRUCounter":           RequestSourceRUCounter,
		"CopReadPrechargeCounter":          CopReadPrechargeCounter,
		"CopReadNoPrechargeCounter":        CopReadNoPrechargeCounter,
		"PagingPrechargeBytesCounter":      PagingPrechargeBytesCounter,
		"PagingActualBytesCounter":         PagingActualBytesCounter,
		"PagingPredictionResidualBytes":    PagingPredictionResidualBytes,
	}
	snapshots := map[string]interface{}{}
	for name, collector := range collectors {
		registry := prometheus.NewRegistry()
		registry.MustRegister(collector)
		families, err := registry.Gather()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(families) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: families %d", name, len(families))
		}
		snapshots[name] = families[0]
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(snapshots)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var normalized interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &normalized); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stripCreationTimes(normalized)
	payload, err = json.MarshalIndent(normalized, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("PD_METRICS_ORACLE")+"/resource_group.json", payload, 0600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func stripCreationTimes(v interface{}) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case map[string]interface{}:
		delete(x, "created_timestamp")
		for _, child := range x {
			stripCreationTimes(child)
		}
	case []interface{}:
		for _, child := range x {
			stripCreationTimes(child)
		}
	}
}
